item.title: Four medaka fish flew into space in 1994; 43 eggs were laid and eight baby fish hatched
item.description: Astronaut Chiaki Mukai took four medaka fish into space in July 1994 as part of an experiment to study reproduction in microgravity. The fish laid eggs during the mission, with eight of 43 identified eggs hatching in space. After returning to Earth, the adult fish gradually recovered, while the young “space medaka” continued to grow normally. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Washington releases 20 lab-raised sunflower stars to restore kelp forests
item.description: In a remarkable conservation initiative, twenty lab-raised sunflower sea stars have been released back into the Salish Sea. The project, undertaken in collaboration with the Samish Indian Nation and various researchers, symbolizes hope for restoring ecological balance in the region. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
